title: Đảo ngữ nhấn mạnh: Never have I, Not only
summary: Đưa trạng từ phủ định lên đầu và đảo trợ động từ: Never have I…, Not only… but also, Hardly… when, Only then…

dialogue.en: How was the concert last night?
dialogue.vi: Buổi hòa nhạc tối qua thế nào?

dialogue.en: Amazing! [[Never have I]] heard such a beautiful voice.
dialogue.vi: Tuyệt vời! Chưa bao giờ mình nghe giọng hát hay như vậy.
Sân vận động có kín không?

dialogue.en: Yes. [[Not only was it]] full, [[but]] people were also standing outside.
dialogue.vi: Có. Không chỉ kín mà còn có người đứng bên ngoài.

dialogue.en: Very late. [[Hardly had I]] got home [[when]] it started to rain.
dialogue.vi: Rất muộn. Mình vừa về đến nhà thì trời mưa.

sections.heading: Never / Rarely / Seldom + trợ động từ + S
sections.rule: Đưa **never, rarely, seldom, little** lên đầu câu → **đảo trợ động từ lên trước chủ ngữ** như câu hỏi. Văn trang trọng, kể chuyện.

examples.en: [[Never have I]] seen such a mess.
examples.vi: Chưa bao giờ tôi thấy bừa bộn như vậy.
examples.why: = I have never seen such a mess.

examples.vi: Hiếm khi cô ấy phàn nàn.
examples.why: Hiện tại đơn → does + S + V.

examples.en: [[Little did he]] know about the plan.
examples.vi: Anh ấy chẳng hề biết về kế hoạch.
examples.why: Quá khứ đơn → did + S + V.

check.explain: Never đầu câu → đảo: have I eaten.

sections.heading: Not only + trợ động từ + S…, but… also
sections.rule: **Not only** đầu câu → đảo ở vế đầu; vế sau dùng **but (S) also** bình thường.

examples.en: [[Not only is]] he smart, [[but]] he is also kind.
examples.vi: Anh ấy không chỉ thông minh mà còn tốt bụng.

examples.en: [[Not only did]] they win, [[but]] they also broke the record.
examples.vi: Họ không chỉ thắng mà còn phá kỷ lục.

check.prompt: Not only ___ late, but she also forgot the tickets.
check.explain: Not only đầu câu → đảo: was she.

sections.heading: Hardly… when, No sooner… than, Only then
sections.rule: **Hardly / Scarcely had + S + V3 + when…** và **No sooner had + S + V3 + than…** = vừa… thì… **Only then / Only after… + đảo**.

examples.en: [[Hardly had]] we sat down [[when]] the phone rang.
examples.vi: Chúng tôi vừa ngồi xuống thì điện thoại reo.

examples.en: [[No sooner had]] she left [[than]] he arrived.
examples.vi: Cô ấy vừa đi thì anh ấy đến.

examples.en: [[Only then did]] I understand the problem.
examples.vi: Chỉ lúc đó tôi mới hiểu vấn đề.

check.prompt: No sooner had I arrived ___ it started to snow.

mistakes.wrong: Never I have seen such a view.
mistakes.right: Never have I seen such a view.

mistakes.wrong: Rarely she goes out at night.
mistakes.right: Rarely does she go out at night.
mistakes.why: Đảo với does + V nguyên mẫu.

mistakes.wrong: Not only he is rich, but he is also famous.
mistakes.right: Not only is he rich, but he is also famous.

mistakes.wrong: No sooner had we left when it rained.
mistakes.right: No sooner had we left than it rained.

mistakes.wrong: Hardly I had arrived when he called.
mistakes.right: Hardly had I arrived when he called.

exercises.explain: Rarely đầu câu → do you find.

exercises.prompt: Not only ___ the exam, but he also got the top score.
Hardly had the film started ___ the lights went off.
Only after the meeting ___ the truth.
exercises.explain: Only after… → đảo: did I learn.

options: Never have I been so happy.
Never I have been so happy.

exercises.prompt: Never ___ I seen such a big fish.
No sooner had I sat down ___ the bus left.
Not only ___ she sing, but she also dances.

exercises.vi: Chưa bao giờ tôi mệt như vậy.
Hiếm khi anh ấy đến muộn.

exercises.sentence: Never I have heard that story.
answers: Never have I heard that story.

exercises.sentence: Not only she is beautiful, but also clever.
answers: Not only is she beautiful, but she is also clever.
exercises.explain: Đảo ở vế đầu; vế sau đủ chủ ngữ.

exercises.sentence: Hardly had I closed my eyes than the baby cried.
answers: Hardly had I closed my eyes when the baby cried.

exercises.vi: Chưa bao giờ tôi thấy cảnh đẹp như vậy.
answers: Never have I seen such a beautiful view.
Never have I seen such beautiful scenery.

answers: Hardly had we arrived when it started to rain.
